# Huiying Filter Data

> Canonical product database for the huiying filter manufacturer — structured SKU records,
> reference-level vehicle-fitment framework and filter reference data (media, OE prefix
> patterns, size ranges, replacement intervals, procurement). Machine-readable, zero
> marketing. 61 SKUs across 8 categories. Operator: Qinghe County Huiying Automotive Parts Co.,
> Ltd. — commercial catalog and inquiries at huiyingfilter.com.

- [Home](https://data.huiying.com/): data-site overview, section index and honest data posture.
- [SKU Index](https://data.huiying.com/products/): all 61 SKUs (identity verified; specs NEEDS_VERIFICATION).
- [Air Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/air-filter/): 21 SKUs.
- [Cabin Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/cabin-filter/): 2 SKUs.
- [Oil Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/oil-filter/): 16 SKUs.
- [Fuel Filter category](https://data.huiying.com/products/fuel-filter/): 6 SKUs.
- [Wiper category](https://data.huiying.com/products/wiper/): 0 SKUs.
- [Brake Pads category](https://data.huiying.com/products/brake-pads/): 2 SKUs.
- [Spark Plugs category](https://data.huiying.com/products/spark-plugs/): 1 SKU.
- [Rubber Hoses category](https://data.huiying.com/products/rubber-hoses/): 13 SKUs.

## Notes

- Per-SKU dimensions, material, efficiency, OE numbers and packing are NOT published by the
  source catalogue; they are marked `NEEDS_VERIFICATION` here, never invented.
- Vehicle fitment is `reference` only — common applications, not verified OE cross-references.
- Commercial catalog and quotations: huiyingfilter.com (this data site is reference-only).
